'''Star Tours Flight 325''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] just before a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] at the Star Tours space station. It was on time and set to leave Gate 1F at 1615 hours.
